details.title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

details.parties_quote:
**FINSERVE CAPITAL PRIVATE LIMITED**, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at 11th Floor, One BKC Tower, G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), Mumbai 400051, Maharashtra, India (together with its Affiliates, the "Company"); and

**ATLIQ TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED**, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456; GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3), having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India (the "Recipient")
details.services_summary: Development of data analytics and reporting solutions for lending and wealth businesses.
details.one_sided_note: Titled mutual, but obligations and restrictions (including confidentiality, residual use rights, survival, non-compete, and non-solicit) bind the Recipient (AtliQ) only, while the Company retains residual use rights and disclaims warranties.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Recipient shall not provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction
restrictive_covenants.customers: any bank, non-banking financial company, wealth manager, broker or fintech platform operating in India that offers products substantially similar to those of the Company
restrictive_covenants.quote: In order to protect the Confidential Information, the Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its termination, provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.

findings.title: One-sided definition of Confidential Information
findings.why: Protects only the client's information, making the NDA entirely unilateral despite being titled mutual or applied generally.
findings.comparison: Confidentiality should be mutual according to AtliQ's principles.
findings.quote: Confidential Information means all information, in any form, disclosed or made available by or on behalf of the Company to the Recipient

findings.title: Extremely short personal data breach notification window
findings.why: A 6-hour notification window is operationally very difficult to meet and creates severe breach risk for AtliQ.
findings.comparison: Stricter than standard 24 to 72-hour statutory notification windows.
findings.quote: notify the Company of any personal data breach within six (6) hours

findings.title: Perpetual survival of confidentiality obligations
findings.why: Creates an indefinite liability and compliance burden for AtliQ.
findings.comparison: Most past contracts survive for 6 to 12 months, not in perpetuity.
findings.quote: The obligations of the Recipient under this Agreement shall survive termination and shall continue in perpetuity.

findings.title: Restrictive non-compete covenant covering competitors
findings.why: Blocks AtliQ from working with a broad category of financial competitors in India for 12 months.
findings.comparison: Conflicts with AtliQ's principle to avoid non-competes that restrict future business.
findings.quote: the Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its termination, provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.

findings.title: One-sided and uncapped indemnification for breach
findings.why: Creates an unmutual, uncapped obligation covering all losses and legal fees for any breach.
findings.comparison: Indemnity should be mutual and proportionate.
findings.quote: The Recipient shall indemnify the Company for all losses, costs and expenses (including legal fees) arising from any breach of this Agreement

findings.title: Unilateral security policy compliance obligation
findings.why: AtliQ must dynamically comply with unilaterally changing client security policies without prior agreement.
findings.comparison: Not standard in standard mutual NDAs.
findings.quote: apply security measures no less stringent than those required under the Company's information-security policy as notified to the Recipient from time to time

findings.title: Extended non-solicitation period of 24 months
findings.why: Restricts hiring for two years post-termination, limiting talent mobility.
findings.comparison: Most confidentiality agreements run 6 to 12 months.
findings.quote: for a period of twenty-four (24) months after its termination, directly or indirectly solicit, hire or engage any employee or consultant of the Company.

findings.title: Residuals clause limited to the Company
findings.why: Only grants residuals rights to the Company, leaving AtliQ exposed regarding unmemorized or general knowledge.
findings.comparison: Residuals clauses should generally be mutual.
findings.quote: Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement, the Company shall be free to use Residuals for any purpose

findings.title: Asymmetric assignment rights
findings.why: Only the counterparty can assign the agreement to affiliates, while AtliQ cannot.
findings.comparison: Standard is mutual restriction or mutual affiliate assignment.
findings.quote: The Recipient may not assign this Agreement. The Company may assign it to any Affiliate.
